lines: # Adaptive rejection sampler (Gilks & Wild, 1992), tangent-based version.
# Derivatives of log f are obtained numerically, so only f is required.
# Hull object ("hull"): list(x, h, dh, z, lb, ub)
#   x sorted abscissae, h = log f(x), dh = h'(x), z = k+1 knots of the
#   upper hull (z[1] = lb, z[k+1] = ub, interior knots = tangent intersections).
ars_check_inputs <- function(f, n, lb, ub, x_init) {
if (!is.function(f)) stop("'f' must be a function (vectorized density).")
if (!is.numeric(n) || length(n) != 1 || is.na(n) || n < 0 || n != floor(n))
stop("'n' must be a single non-negative integer.")
stop("'lb' and 'ub' must be single numeric values (may be infinite).")
if (lb >= ub) stop("Invalid domain: need lb < ub.")
stop("'x_init' must contain at least two distinct finite numbers.")
stop("'x_init' must lie strictly inside (lb, ub).")
stop("Density 'f' must return non-negative, non-NA values, one per input.")
# Central difference, switching to one-sided if too close to a finite bound.
lo <- pmax(x - eps, lb); hi <- pmin(x + eps, ub)
# Check slopes are non-increasing (log-concavity) and build knots.
build_hull <- function(x, h, dh, lb, ub, tol = 1e-6) {
o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; h <- h[o]; dh <- dh[o]
stop("Density is not log-concave: slope of log f increases between ",
if (k > 1) {  # each tangent must lie above neighbouring points of log f
bad <- h[j + 1] > h[j] + dh[j] * (x[j + 1] - x[j]) + tol * pmax(1, abs(h[j + 1])) |
h[j] > h[j + 1] + dh[j + 1] * (x[j] - x[j + 1]) + tol * pmax(1, abs(h[j]))
stop("Density is not log-concave: tangent at x = ", signif(x[which(bad)[1]], 5),
" lies below log f at a neighbouring point.")
z <- numeric(k + 1); z[1] <- lb; z[k + 1] <- ub
# keep knots between neighbouring abscissae despite round-off
list(x = x, h = h, dh = dh, z = z, lb = lb, ub = ub)
# Upper hull value at points xs (vector).
# Lower hull (chords); -Inf outside [min x, max x].
if (any(ins)) out[ins] <- approx(x, h, xout = xs[ins])$y
# Log of the mass of each exponential piece exp(h_j + d_j (x - x_j)) on [a, b].
k <- length(hull$x); a <- hull$z[1:k]; b <- hull$z[2:(k + 1)]
# Draw one point from the normalized upper hull.
p <- exp(lm - max(lm)); j <- sample.int(length(p), 1, prob = p)
a <- hull$z[j]; b <- hull$z[j + 1]; d <- hull$dh[j]; u <- runif(1)
x <- b + log(e + u * (1 - e)) / d
# Choose starting abscissae; for unbounded sides ensure slope has correct sign.
init_hull <- function(logf, lb, ub, x_init, max_expand = 60) {
x <- if (user) sort(unique(x_init)) else default_init(lb, ub)
if (sum(ok) < 2) stop("Density is zero/non-finite at the starting points; supply 'x_init'.")
if (!is.finite(hn)) stop("Cannot find starting points with positive density.")
x <<- c(x, xn); h <<- c(h, hn); dh <<- c(dh, num_deriv(logf, xn, lb, ub))
o <- order(x); x <<- x[o]; h <<- h[o]; dh <<- dh[o]
if ((i <- i + 1) > max_expand) stop("Density appears not integrable on the left (h' <= 0 as x -> -Inf).")
if ((i <- i + 1) > max_expand) stop("Density appears not integrable on the right (h' >= 0 as x -> Inf).")
# Insert a new abscissa into the hull (rebuilds knots).
build_hull(c(hull$x, xn), c(hull$h, hn), c(hull$dh, dn), hull$lb, hull$ub)
# f: vectorized (possibly unnormalized) density; n: number of samples;
# lb, ub: support; x_init: optional starting points.
ars <- function(f, n, lb = -Inf, ub = Inf, x_init = NULL, max_iter = 1e6) {
if ((iter <- iter + 1) > max_iter) stop("Exceeded max_iter without producing enough samples.")
lo <- lower_eval(hull, x); up <- upper_eval(hull, x)
if (is.finite(lo) && log(u) <= lo - up) {      # squeeze test: accept, no f evaluation
if (is.finite(hx) && hx > up + tol * max(1, abs(up)))
stop("Density is not log-concave: log f exceeds the upper hull at x = ", signif(x, 5))
if (is.finite(lo) && hx < lo - tol * max(1, abs(lo)))
stop("Density is not log-concave: log f falls below the lower hull at x = ", signif(x, 5))
if (log(u) <= hx - up) { got <- got + 1; out[got] <- x }
if (is.finite(hx)) hull <- update_hull(hull, x, hx, logf)
# Compare samples with a known CDF (KS test) and known mean/sd.
check_dist <- function(name, x, cdf, mu, sigma, tol_z = 4) {
n <- length(x); m <- mean(x); s <- sd(x)
pass <- ks > 0.001 && zm < tol_z && abs(s / sigma - 1) < 0.1
report(name, pass, sprintf("mean=%.4f (true %.4f), sd=%.4f (true %.4f), KS p=%.3f", m, mu, s, sigma, ks))
msg <- tryCatch({ force(expr); NA_character_ }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
if (is.na(msg)) "(no error raised)" else paste0("-> ", msg))
# hull: upper >= log f >= lower for a normal
xs <- c(-2, -0.5, 1, 2.5); hl <- build_hull(xs, lf(xs), -xs, -Inf, Inf)
res <- c(res, report("NUM_DERIV", max(abs(num_deriv(lf, g, -Inf, Inf) + g)) < 1e-6))
# upper hull sampler: exact envelope mass check via draws from the envelope
emp <- tabulate(findInterval(e, hl$z[-c(1, length(hl$z))]) + 1, length(masses)) / length(e)
sprintf("max segment prob error=%.4f", max(abs(emp - masses)))))
x <- ars(dnorm, n); res <- c(res, check_dist("NORMAL", x, pnorm, 0, 1))
x <- ars(dexp, n, lb = 0); res <- c(res, check_dist("EXPONENTIAL", x, pexp, 1, 1))
x <- ars(function(x) dnorm(x, 3, 2) * 17, n)  # unnormalized, shifted
res <- c(res, check_dist("UNNORMALIZED_NORMAL", x, function(q) pnorm(q, 3, 2), 3, 2))
res <- c(res, check_dist("GAMMA(3,2)", x, function(q) pgamma(q, 3, 2), 1.5, sqrt(3) / 2))
x <- ars(function(x) dbeta(x, 2, 3), n, lb = 0, ub = 1)
res <- c(res, check_dist("BETA(2,3)", x, function(q) pbeta(q, 2, 3), 0.4, sqrt(0.04)))
res <- c(res, check_dist("TRUNCATED_NORMAL", x, function(q) (pnorm(q) - 0.5) / (pnorm(1.5) - 0.5), tm, sqrt(tv)))
res <- c(res, check_dist("LOGISTIC", x, plogis, 0, pi / sqrt(3)))
cat(sprintf("=== Tests passed: %d of %d ===\n", sum(res), length(res)))
